configurator_compatibility_rules._description: Rules for the AI PC Configurator feature. Use these fields to validate GPU + CPU + motherboard + PSU compatibility.

pcie_rules.note: GPU pcie_version must be <= motherboard PCIe slot version. GPU will operate at lower gen if slot is older — flag with warning not block.
pcie_rules.critical_flag: Intel Arc GPUs require PCIe 4.0 minimum for full performance. Flag PCIe 3.0 motherboards as incompatible with Arc.

power_rules.note: Sum all component TDP values. PSU wattage should be total_tdp * 1.25 minimum. Flag if PSU < recommended_psu_watts on GPU spec.
power_rules.connector_note: 16-pin (ATX 3.0/3.1) connector required for RTX 50 and RTX 40 series. Flag if PSU only has 8-pin connectors without adapter.

slot_physical_rules.note: Check case clearance. slot_size and length_mm must fit within chosen case maximum GPU length and slot clearance.

nvlink_rules.note: NVLink requires both GPUs to be identical model and same NVLink generation. Only supported on RTX 3090/3090Ti (Ampere) and RTX 6000 Ada (Pro). Flag mismatch as incompatible.
nvlink_rules.consumer_nvlink_dropped: NVLink dropped on all consumer GeForce RTX 40 and RTX 50 series. Multi-GPU only via PCIe switch boards for those generations.

socket_compatibility.note: GPU compatible_sockets field lists CPU socket families the GPU is validated/recommended with. This is informational — GPUs are not socket-specific, but flags unusual pairings for review.

gpu_rack_compatibility.note: For professional/data-center GPUs, compatible_gpu_racks lists validated rack enclosures. Consumer GPUs default to standard ATX/EATX workstation cases.
